question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

A person who is critical of the motives of others
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"cynic"** refers to a person who believes that people are motivated purely by self-interest rather than acting for honorable or unselfish reasons. (संशयी व्यक्ति)

 
 
• **Example: **As a **cynic**, he often doubts the true intentions behind charitable acts.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1 i.e. Cynic.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Interviewer** (साक्षात्कारकर्ता): A person who asks questions, especially in a professional context, like for a job interview.

 
 
• **Example:** The interviewer asked several difficult questions during the job interview.
 
 
 
• **Chauffeur** (चालक): A person employed to drive a private or hired car.
 
 
• **Example:** He hired a chauffeur to drive him around the city.
 
 
 
• **Curator** (संग्रहपाल): A keeper or custodian of a museum or other collection.
 
 
• **Example:** The curator organized an exhibition of ancient artifacts.
